issue_context.title: box_url not using system ssh config for settings
issue_context.body:
Im trying to distribute a packaged base box and I want to use one of my existing servers that global developers have access to with a pem file.

I am aware of vagrant cloud but that is not an option in this case.

It looks like the packaged curl command does indeed support `scp` but for some reason it is not respecting the values I have in my `~/.ssh/config` and it's not providing the identity file and username when vagrant up is ran.

I can confirm that the following command does work when specifying the identity file with the `--key` option while using the version of `curl` that is packaged with vagrant.

```bash
/opt/vagrant/embedded/bin/curl --verbose \
  "scp://redacteddomain.com:/path/to/custom_box.box" --insecure \
  --key ~/.ssh/my-key.pem --user admin: --output test.box
```

How can i pass the required options to the `base_url` or make the packaged version of curl respect my ssh config file?

Here is the config block im using in my `vagrantfile`
```ruby
  config.vm.define :devbox, primary: true do |devbox|
    devbox.vm.box_download_insecure = true
    devbox.vm.box = "base-box"
    devbox.vm.box_url = "scp://redacteddomain.com:/path/to/custom_box.box"
  end
```

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated, I have wasted about 10 hours on this so far.

### Vagrant version

Vagrant 2.2.7

### Host operating system
macOS Catalina 10.15.4


### Vagrantfile

```ruby
# -*- mode: ruby -*-
# vi: set ft=ruby :

VAGRANTFILE_API_VERSION = "2"

Vagrant.configure(VAGRANTFILE_API_VERSION) do |config|
 
  config.vm.define :example, primary: true do |example|
    example.vm.box_download_insecure = true
    example.vm.box = "custom_box"
    example.vm.box_url = ["scp://myurl.com:/opt/vagrant/custom_box.box"]

    example.vm.network "private_network", ip: "192.168.33.10"
    example.vm.network :forwarded_port, guest: 22, host: 2222, id: 'ssh'
    example.vm.synced_folder "./", "/example", :mount_options => ["dmode=777","fmode=777"]
    example.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |v|
      v.memory = 4096
      v.customize ["modifyvm", :id, "--cpus", "2"]
    end
  end
end
```


### Debug output

https://gist.github.com/peledies/2baab7f568a7377e6de748049e92841f

### Expected behavior

Vagrant should use the `~/.ssh/config` file to make its curl request when using the `scp` option.
OR
Allow configuration options to specify ssh keys or other relevant options as an array would be acceptable

### Actual behavior

The box download fails with an `Authentication Failure`

### Steps to reproduce

1. put a packaged base box on a server you have access to with private key authentication
2. use the box_url option in your vagrant file
3. use the scp protocol for the box download
4. create an entry for the domain your base box is located at in your .ssh/config file using an identity file
4. vagrant up

### References

I tried using the instructions that the internet mostly points to located here:

https://chase-seibert.github.io/blog/2014/05/18/vagrant-authenticated-private-box-urls.html

but that solution is from 2014 and is no longer relavent.
